goal: Token and context watching runs on the VM as ga-engine code with no model call, and replaces the Claude watcher session.
why: User 10-06 23:2x: watching rules as VM code; an independent check outside the Claude sessions it measures.
acceptance: reads the published session snapshot (baseline ops/hub/cloud_sessions.json: per-session ctx, cost, status) and the ga ledgers; no Claude credentials on the VM
alarms by fixed rules: ctx over the cap on a non-completed session, one session's cost rising faster than a set rate, total cost rising faster than a set rate, snapshot older than a set age
thresholds come from a config file Ops owns; defaults: ctx 150000, 5 USD/h per session, 12 USD/h total, snapshot 2 h
each alarm is mailed once per kind per session per day as notify/1 kind alert to baseline-ops; a stale snapshot alarm also reaches the user
no model call on this path (a test fails if one is added); deterministic for the same inputs
constraints: spec only: Dev decides method and plan
